method: Viewed actual UE output images after final smooth-normal/full-precision UV refinement
result: Four common views retain forest, inland lake and separate coast. Foam and bright caustic-like patterns are visible; timed frames show changed water patterns. Rounded silhouettes and restrained palette retained.
limitations: Triangle-atlas seams remain visible in closeups despite reduced contrast.
Small grass/stalk triangles have limited texture detail at 16 px/m.
Water is opaque artistic shading; shoreline wave motion may expose a narrow edge shadow.
Inland lake retains original static material.
